enum.atlasNote.indigenousTribes: Tribe locations from the Council of Indigenous Peoples (2022-07) × currently approved tribes (2026-09); gray points = not on the current approved list. 13 currently approved tribes have no location and are not plotted.
enum.atlasNote.indigenousIsolationRisk: Each point is the representative center of an area, not its extent; 3 records have no source coordinates and use a village representative point instead.
enum.atlasNote.agriRuralCommunityVillage: Rural community classification by village (Agency of Rural Development and Soil and Water Conservation, Ministry of Agriculture); shown at zoom 7 and above.
enum.atlasNote.provincialRoadSigns: Provincial highway sign inventory by the Highway Bureau, MOTC; points appear at zoom 11 and above, and as a heat zone at lower zoom. Survey dates vary by record; not real-time conditions.
enum.atlasNote.provincialRoadMileposts: Shown at zoom 11 and above. Survey dates vary by record.
enum.atlasNote.freewayTrafficSigns: Traffic signs from the Taiwan Area National Freeway Bureau, MOTC; shown at zoom 10 and above. About a quarter of signs have no code name in the source (gray points).
enum.atlasNote.freewayInterchanges: National freeway interchanges from the Taiwan Area National Freeway Bureau, MOTC (207 sites).
enum.atlasNote.freewayEcoSensitive: Sensitivity level is the source's own grading; the source does not say which direction is higher, so only shades of one color are used.
enum.atlasNote.provincialRoadMonitored: Provincial highway disaster-monitoring sections; only the general threshold text is shown, and real-time road closure status is not in this layer. Shown at zoom 8 and above.
enum.atlasNote.provincialRoadEmergencyBa: Provincial highway emergency pull-over bays (lists for ROC years 112–113, i.e. 2023–2024); light purple = appears only in an older year's list.
enum.atlasNote.floodDisasterPointsNcdr: Flood disaster points from NCDR, dated to the year only; coverage in 2023 is insufficient, and counts are report rows, not the number of floods.
enum.atlasNote.taipeiWaterloggingHistory: Historical waterlogged areas in Taipei City; the depth unit is not stated in the source and is inferred to be centimeters from the value range.
enum.atlasNote.swcbDisasterPhotoPoints: Photo locations of sediment disasters from the Agency of Rural Development and Soil and Water Conservation (34,419 photos); only photo links are given, images are not embedded. Shown as a heat zone at low zoom.
enum.atlasNote.cetaceanStrandings: Cetacean stranding events; 83 records without coordinates are not plotted. Orange points = coordinates differ from the reported county (suspect, not corrected).
enum.atlasNote.seaTurtleStrandings: Sea turtle stranding events; 543 records (about 24%) without coordinates are not plotted. Orange points = coordinates differ from the reported county (suspect, not corrected).
enum.atlasNote.beachWaterQuality: Bathing beach water quality, sampled during the swimming season only; color shows the grade of the latest sample.
enum.atlasNote.marineMicroplastics: Marine microplastics survey stations (2021–2023); color shows the mean total concentration at the surface. Station positions are the mean of each cruise's coordinates.
enum.atlasNote.marinePollutionIncidents: Marine pollution incidents (since 2003); 62 records without coordinates (including 2 recorded as (0,0) in the source) are not plotted; 60 records fall outside the area around Taiwan and are drawn as given by the source.
enum.atlasNote.namrEdnaSurveySites: eDNA survey sites of the National Academy of Marine Research (converted from degrees-minutes-seconds).
enum.atlasNote.placeNames: Taiwan place-name data from the Ministry of the Interior: each entity is drawn as one point, and 105 points with precision worse than 1.2 km are not plotted; shown in stages by category (natural z9, villages and settlements z12, landmarks z14).
enum.atlasNote.triangulationPoints: Triangulation points of the Ministry of the Interior (TWD67 degrees-minutes-seconds converted to WGS84, about ±10 m).
enum.atlasNote.wraFloodgatesCentral: Survey results from 1999–2000, not current conditions; open/closed status is not available.
enum.atlasNote.wraCentralDrainage: Extent of centrally managed regional drainage facilities (33 channels).
enum.atlasNote.iowStructureMonitoring: Levee and gate structural-safety monitoring stations of the Water Resources Agency's IoT network (station baseline, not real-time values).
enum.atlasNote.wraDredgingPoints: River dredging project points (snapshot); most coordinates are given to only 2 decimal places (about ±1 km), so check the precision in the popup. The unit of quantity is not stated in the source.
enum.atlasNote.wraEcologySurveySites: River ecology survey sites of the Water Resources Agency (1995–2019, not updated after 2019); color shows the number of species.

enum.atlasPrecision.來源無座標，以村里代表點代替: No source coordinates; village representative point used

enum.atlasPrecision.來源經緯度（地區代表中心點，非範圍）: Source longitude/latitude (representative center of the area, not its extent)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源點位（定位方式未說明；只到年）: Source point (positioning method not stated; date given to the year only)
enum.atlasPrecision.拍攝點位（來源未說明定位方式）: Photo location (positioning method not stated by the source)
enum.atlasPrecision.各航次座標平均；航次間位置差 >1 km: Mean of cruise coordinates; positions differ by >1 km between cruises, needs review
enum.atlasPrecision.來源經緯度（與來源行政區一致）: Source longitude/latitude (consistent with the source administrative area)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源經緯度（與來源行政區不一致）: Source longitude/latitude (inconsistent with the source administrative area)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源 TM2 座標（來源 X／Y 欄對調: Source TM2 coordinates (X/Y fields swapped in the source; corrected)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源座標只到小數 2 位（約 ±1 km: Source coordinates to 2 decimal places only (about ±1 km)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源座標只到小數 1 位（約 ±10 k: Source coordinates to 1 decimal place only (about ±10 km)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源座標只到整數度（約 ±100 km）: Source coordinates to whole degrees only (about ±100 km)
enum.atlasPrecision.來源 TM2 座標與度分秒不一致，已不採: Source TM2 coordinates disagree with the degrees-minutes-seconds values and are not used
enum.atlasOrg.forestry: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency, MOA
enum.atlasReefBasis.vertex_mean: Mean of listed vertices (not an official center)
enum.atlasNote.natureReserves: Nature reserves nationwide (including land, not limited to the sea); dates are gazetted dates, not data freshness. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.wildlifeProtectedAreas: Wildlife protected areas nationwide (including land, not limited to the sea); polygons sharing a name are separate zones. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.openFishingLocations: Open fishing locations published by the Ocean Conservation Administration; points are not extents and do not indicate access or safety. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.coastalAreaExtents: 2022 (ROC 111, 2022-09-13) coastal area extents; not the current coastline or restrictions. 7 degenerate polygons smaller than 1 m² (Kinmen) are not drawn; small islets appear when zoomed in. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.artificialReefCenters: Center position, not the extent: centers parsed from the announced coordinate text of artificial reef no-fishing areas (extent rules in the popup); some points are vertex means, not official centers. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.protectedReefCenters: Center position, not the extent: centers parsed from the announced coordinate text of protected reef no-fishing areas (mostly midpoints of line A–B); 1 area with only a place-name description is not drawn. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.setNetFishingAreas: Set-net fishery right areas (edition 2025-08-05), reprojected to lon/lat; not an indication of current permits, access or navigational safety. For reference only; not a determination of legal applicability.
enum.atlasNote.landSubsidenceStations: Coverage: GNSS 2011-01–2025-12, magnetic rings 1995-07–2026-03, deep piles 2016-05–2025-04. A single station does not represent the whole area; the three types measure differently and are not comparable. Click a station for its trend.
enum.atlasNote.landSubsidenceCumulative: Cumulative subsidence contours (mm); negative = subsidence. Defaults to each county's latest edition; switch editions in the layer settings. A few short lines are hidden below zoom 9.
enum.atlasNote.landSubsidenceRate: Mean subsidence rate contours (cm/yr); negative = subsidence. Defaults to each county's latest edition. Missing: 2015–2017 national maps (SHP only, not obtained) and 2018–2019 national maps (no values in source).
enum.atlasNote.seawallZones: General seawall zones (compiled by source 2024-06-12); managing offices normalized to the current River Branch names. Visible from zoom 8.
enum.landSubsidenceCoord.valid_4326_conf: Source coordinates (TWD97 and WGS84 columns disagree)

enum.atlasNote.cultureCoinVenues: 4,264 arts shops and venues that accept the Culture Coin (downloaded 2026-10-24; the source file carries no date). 342 had (0,0) coordinates in the source and were placed from their addresses. Street performers are not included. Registered street-performer counts are in the Statistics tab under Culture & Arts.
enum.atlasChsKind.township_group: Township only (township center, not the actual site)
enum.atlasNote.culturalHealthStations: 525 Indigenous cultural health stations (directory dated 2025-07-22). Solid dots are the 191 stations located from their addresses; hollow rings are the 334 stations located only to their township, merged into one ring at the township center with the number of stations inside — not actual sites, so do not use them for distances. Phone numbers are not included.

enum.atlasOrg.fnp: National Property Administration, Ministry of Finance
enum.atlasNote.twcServiceOffices: Addresses of 137 Taiwan Water Corporation units — head office, regional offices, operation and service offices, water plant offices (data.gov.tw update 2024-11-22). 16 units share an address with another unit, so their points overlap. Water plant offices are offices; the treatment facilities themselves are in TWC Water Facilities.
enum.atlasNote.twcWaterFacilities: 486 TWC treatment plants, wells, desalination plants and others (data.gov.tw update 2024-08-22; 1 row without coordinates not drawn). 19 rows are the 17 plants on TWC's list of large treatment plants (>200,000 CMD; Fengshan phases 1 and 2 are two rows at one point), linked by name with design output — not separate facilities. The OSM Water Facilities layer may also show the same plant. 12 names have characters lost in the source encoding (?).
enum.atlasNote.taisugarSugarMills: 14 Taisugar sugar mill sites (data.gov.tw update 2024-08-14); Nanjing's source coordinates did not match its address's county, so it is placed from the address. These are sites only, not Taisugar land holdings (Taisugar lease land statistics are in the Statistics tab under Housing & Property).
enum.atlasNote.statePropertyTenderListin: State land (759) and buildings with land (188) announced for tender and not yet sold by the National Property Administration (snapshot downloaded 2026-10-24; the source updates about every one to two weeks; 8 rows could not be located). Land points are lot centroids and building points are street addresses — open a point for its positional accuracy; 7 fall in a different township from the one listed. Announced land value is a per-m² figure, not the reserve price.

enum.atlasNote.atmSitesFisc: 27,412 ATM installation sites from the FISC roster (snapshot 2026-10-24; 22 sites that could not be located are not drawn). Each dot is one installation site, not one machine: a site may have several; FISC counted 33,712 interbank ATMs in September 2026. Coordinates come from mixed sources (Ministry of Digital Affairs, Chunghwa Post, address geocoding, Google); open a dot to see its location accuracy. 222 sites are only approximately located; 865 are marked in the roster as not open to the public. Wheelchair and voice flags are self-reported in the roster. Below zoom 10 the layer shows a heat map.
enum.atlasNote.financialBranchesFisc: 4,989 head and branch offices of financial institutions from the FISC roster (snapshot 2026-10-24; 1 that could not be located is not drawn): domestic, foreign and mainland Chinese banks, credit cooperatives, farmers' and fishermen's association credit departments, Chunghwa Post savings units and bills finance companies. Coordinates come from mixed sources; open a dot to see its location accuracy. 160 are only approximately located. The roster lists only 2 Chunghwa Post savings units, not local post offices (see the Post Office layer).

enum.atlasNote.securitiesFuturesInstitut: 1,071 offices: 817 securities firm branches, 39 futures firm head offices and 90 branches, 36 investment trust and 89 investment advisory companies (rosters downloaded 2026-10-24; 33 with no business address in the roster, such as proprietary desks or firms exempt from a trading hall, are not drawn). These are roster offices, not counts of brokers or accounts; a securities firm's futures desk appears once in each roster, so points at the same address overlap. Securities firm head offices are not included. Some coordinates reuse an ATM site or financial branch at the same address (G10), others are address geocodes; open a dot to see its location accuracy. 8 are only approximately located.
enum.atlasNote.insuranceInstitutions: 655 sites: 392 insurer head and branch offices (233 life, 156 non-life, 3 reinsurers) and 263 insurance agencies (31 of them banks), rosters downloaded 2026-10-24. Sales offices (about 3,358, no address data) and agents are not included; agency addresses are registered or contact addresses, and banks acting as agents are shown at their head office. Some coordinates reuse an ATM site or financial branch at the same address (G10), others are address geocodes; open a dot to see its location accuracy. 5 are only approximately located.
enum.atlasFinanceCoord.post_5950_same_of: Chunghwa Post office location coordinates (same office code)
enum.atlasNote.postOfficeFxCounters: 290 Chunghwa Post offices that buy and sell foreign cash and traveler's checks (web roster downloaded 2026-10-25). These are not licensed currency exchange shops: the central bank's list of exchange shops (hotels, stores, etc.) approved through Bank of Taiwan is not public, so this layer only has post offices; banks, credit cooperatives and farmers' and fishermen's associations that handle foreign cash have no public per-site roster either. The central bank counts 288 post offices (as of 2026-09-30), 2 fewer than this layer; the dates differ and the cause has not been checked. Coordinates come from Chunghwa Post's office location list (same office code).
